propositions: Closing a task/story/epic must run a separately attested plan-review gate before completion verification to reject tickets when the ticket's plan or upstream pinned plans changed during execution.

The close gate accepts certified, registry-current, material-current, and phase-compatible reviews despite HEAD or per-file dependency drift, but rejects unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility.
The close gate runs zero network or model calls, operates only on local state inside the existing write lock, and fails closed on unexpected read/parse/signature exceptions with verdict unavailable.

A generic pre_status_check callback extension in txn.transition_core runs after structural close checks and fresh state re-read but before STATUS append, allowing higher-level close policy to execute inside the single critical section without double-locking.
With require_plan_review_for_close disabled or absent, close behavior is byte-for-byte equivalent to current behavior and performs no plan-review reads.
